h1: Suphak Hotel — A Budget Hotel in Central Kalasin, Near the Bus Terminal, Walk to the Market
intro: If you arrive in Kalasin by coach and want a low-cost place you can reach on foot once you step off the bus, Suphak Hotel (Thai name: Supak Hotel / Suphak Hotel) has been the budget traveller's go-to for years · A budget hotel on Saneha Road in the city centre, it sits about 200 m from Kalasin Bus Terminal, within walking distance of the market and the Phraya Chaisunthon Monument · What real reviews agree on is the excellent location for coach travellers, rooms that are more spacious than expected, friendly staff and free parking · Rooms from approx ฿350/night

body.html: Suphak Hotel is a long-established Kalasin hotel on Saneha Road, in the city centre · Its clearest selling point is location — the hotel sits about 200 m from Kalasin Bus Terminal, just a few minutes' walk away · For anyone arriving by coach who doesn't want to travel on further, this is one of the most convenient stays in town · It's a building that opened in 2010 and had a major renovation in 2014, with 52 rooms at some of the easiest prices in the city.

Rooms are simple in the budget-hotel mould, with air conditioning, a refrigerator, TV, hot water and free Wi-Fi · Most real guest reviews say the rooms are more spacious than expected, especially the VIP rooms, with comfy beds and clean bathrooms — good value for the price · Options run from a Standard twin up to a larger VIP room · Set expectations first: the building has age and some areas look dated, and a few rooms have older TVs · If you aim for "clean, usable budget hotel" rather than "new and stylish," you'll be happier here.
"Spacious room, comfy bed, very cheap, and you just step off the coach and walk over — so convenient. The staff were kind too."

Service is what wins over budget travellers · Staff are praised for being friendly and helpful, there's a 24-hour front desk, a café, massage service, a convenience store and laundry · A point many mention is the free parking, which is handy for self-drivers · For a hotel at this price, that's a solid set of services.

Location is the heart of the appeal · Beyond being near the bus terminal, it's central — you can walk to the market and the city's food district, and the Phraya Chaisunthon Monument is about 160 m away, with Wat Tai Pho Kham and the Kalasin city museum not far off · Anyone heading on to the Sirindhorn Museum (Dinosaur Town) or Lam Pao Dam can use the city as a base · The overall score sits around 7.4 from real reviews — reflecting a genuinely usable budget pick rather than a luxury stay.

To be honest, Suphak sells value and location, not newness or design · If you want a crisp new room, a boutique feel or a swimming pool, this isn't it — look at Rimpao Hotel or Farisa Garden Hotel, the 3-star options in town, instead · But if you arrive by coach, want the lowest price, a place you can walk to from the terminal, spacious enough, clean, with kind staff and free parking, and you're not fussed about the building's age — Suphak offers value that's hard to find in such a central spot.

A tip from following reviews here: ask for a VIP room if your budget can stretch a little, as they're noticeably more spacious and comfortable than the standard rooms for a small difference · The hotel has no lift, so if you have a lot of luggage or can't manage stairs, ask for a ground-floor room · And during festivals or long weekends when many visit Kalasin, the cheapest rooms go fast, so book ahead.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — Suphak Hotel (Supak) Kalasin

faq.q: Where is Suphak Hotel · is it far from the bus terminal?
faq.a: It's at 81/7 Saneha Road, Mueang District, in central Kalasin, about 200 m from Kalasin Bus Terminal · It's just a few minutes' walk · You can walk to the market and the Phraya Chaisunthon Monument · The Kalasin city museum is about 530 m · The Sirindhorn Museum (Dinosaur Town) is about a 30-minute drive.

faq.q: How much does Suphak Hotel cost · what room types are there?
faq.a: Rooms start from approx ฿350/night for a Standard · There are Standard Double and larger VIP rooms, up to a bigger VIP room around ฿650 · It's one of the cheapest stays in the city centre · Prices vary by date and platform, so compare a few sites before booking.

faq.q: Who is Suphak Hotel best for?
faq.a: It's a great fit for budget travellers arriving by coach who want a central stay, near the bus terminal, walkable to the market, with free parking · Ideal for anyone using Kalasin as a base for Dinosaur Town or Lam Pao Dam who prioritises price and convenience over a new building.

faq.q: Is Suphak Hotel old · are the rooms clean?
faq.a: It's a building that opened in 2010 and was renovated in 2014 · Most reviews say the rooms are more spacious than expected, with comfy beds, clean bathrooms and good value · Worth knowing: some areas look dated, a few rooms have older TVs, and there's no lift — ask for a ground-floor room if you can't manage stairs.

The hotel has free parking, handy for self-drivers · But there is no breakfast service — walk to the market and nearby eateries in the morning · There's also a café, massage service, laundry and a 24-hour front desk.

faq.q: Should I book ahead · what's the review score?
faq.a: The overall score is around 7.4 from real reviews — reflecting a genuinely usable budget pick · On long weekends and festivals when many visit Kalasin, the cheapest rooms go fast, so book ahead and choose a free-cancellation rate if your plans aren't firm.
